lines.en: I drag my steps forward
Wet earth clings to my feet
Each step drops my shoulder
Bones knock beneath my skin
Head tilted, I shuffle along
My fingers are longer than my arms

lines.zh: 我在暗处走得比亮处快
lines.en: I move faster in the dark than the light
I tread across a patch of moss

lines.zh: 每一步都像从梦里拖出来
lines.en: Each step feels dragged out of a dream
I walk along the wall
No shadow falls from my feet
I go toward the sound of your breathing
I stand with my lids half down
I am taking a very long nap
This dream is not a pleasant one
My armor is thick
I do not wish to see anything

lines.zh: 空气里有别人做梦的味道
lines.en: The air smells of someone else's dream
I grind my teeth slowly

lines.zh: 我身上有一百五十多点的底子
lines.en: There are more than a hundred and fifty points in me

lines.zh: 我站着也不比走着轻松
lines.en: Standing is no easier than walking

lines.zh: 我在等一个靠近的声音
lines.en: I wait for a sound coming near
You are in my dream

lines.zh: 你眼底的睡意，我一眼就看见。
lines.en: The sleep in your eyes—I see it at once.
My face is not a pleasant one

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的指骨就碰到你。
lines.en: One step closer and my finger bones touch you.
I may be awake
You carry the heat of blood

lines.zh: 我三十二点甲，睡得很沉
lines.en: Thirty-two points of armour, and a deep sleep

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚边发抖
lines.en: Your shadow trembles at my feet
I see you shivering
Do not scream, screaming does nothing in a dream
I look down at the wound
A bone slipped out of place
That woke me a little
I step back, still slow
A gap opened in my armor
I do not cry out
I tilt my head

lines.zh: 这点伤在梦里不算什么
lines.en: In a dream this wound is nothing
Thirty-two armor; I take it head-on.

lines.zh: 我错开的下巴，合不回原位。
lines.en: My jaw is out of line and will not sit back.
Things in dreams do not fill you
What you bring changes in a dream

lines.zh: 你手里的食物，在我眼里是灰。
lines.en: The food in your hand is ash to my eyes.

lines.zh: 这东西在你手上是热的
lines.en: This is warm in your hand

lines.zh: 我伸手，它就不是原来那样了
lines.en: I reach out and it is no longer the same
Hold it farther away
There is no cure for hunger in a dream

lines.zh: 你留着它，醒过来还要用
lines.en: Keep it, you will need it when you wake
That will not draw me in
I sniff, and there is no smell
You walked into my arms
My body is cold

lines.zh: 你退开时踩到了我的脚
lines.en: You stepped on my foot pulling away

lines.zh: 这一下我在梦里也感觉到了
lines.en: I felt that even in the dream
My armor stopped you
I tilted, and held

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，暖得发烫。
lines.en: You stumble into me, burning warm.
We should not be this close

lines.zh: 我的指节停在半空，改抓你肩膀。
lines.en: My knuckles halt midair, then grip your shoulder.
You had better step back
Ghouls have companions too

lines.zh: 同类相遇，先看谁的梦更长
lines.en: When kin meet, we ask whose dream is longer

lines.zh: 两个一起睡，梦里就热闹
lines.en: Sleeping together makes the dream busy
In the dream, we say nothing.

lines.zh: 它站在我旁边，一动不动
lines.en: It stands beside me without moving
Two shadows overlap
We keep the same graveyard
It moved first, so I follow
We never smile
The dream will speak for us
I pinch it with long fingers
It goes cold in my hand

lines.zh: 这东西像是从梦里带出来的
lines.en: This looks carried out of a dream
I hold it up and look a long while
I do not return dropped things

lines.zh: 我把它塞进护甲的缝里
lines.en: I tuck it into a seam of my armor
I cannot grip it, it is too slick
What is this supposed to be
I hold it and think nothing
If you dropped it, it is mine

lines.zh: 你走进梦的边界，我锁定了。
lines.en: You crossed into the dream's edge. Locked.

lines.zh: 骨颈一节节抬起，我看向你。
lines.en: My bone neck lifts joint by joint; I look at you.
I heard your breathing
This graveyard is mine
I arrive before you sleep

lines.zh: 梦的边上有你的气味，我过去。
lines.en: Your scent clings to the dream's edge. I go there.
The warmth of you stands out
I am no longer sleepy
I have your position
Hiding in the dark will not help
I begin the chase
This dream should end
My fingers are spread
The prey in this dream is you
Your smell is very clear
I need not run, you are not fast

lines.zh: 我记住你走进来的方向
lines.en: I remember the way you came in

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印，不紧不慢。
lines.en: I step in your footprints, unhurried.
I am not fast, but I do not stop
You run more desperately than I walk

lines.zh: 我的长手指已经张开了
lines.en: My long fingers are spread

lines.zh: 你每拐一个弯，就慢一点
lines.en: Every turn slows you

lines.zh: 树影挪了位置，我仍知道你在这。
lines.en: The shadows shift, but I know you're still here.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在骨头上敲得很响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat knocks loudly on my bones.
My steps are behind you
Look back and you will see my face
A little more and you reach the graves

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以不会累
lines.en: I need no breath, so I do not tire
Your strength will run out first
I keep following
Your shadow runs ahead of you
I am at the end of this road
A little closer is enough
Listen, my bones are creaking
I have reached out
You can no longer run
Time to wake
My long fingers clamp on you
That grab came with cold
I raise a hand and bring it down
Bone strikes you

lines.zh: 我的手穿过了你的衣领
lines.en: My hand passed through your collar

lines.zh: 我整条手臂砸下，土都震了。
lines.en: My whole arm slams down and the soil shakes.
My nails rake across
You are pushed against the wall
I clench my teeth and say nothing
This blow is to wake you

lines.zh: 我的爪子擦过你，带下一片衣角。
lines.en: My claws graze you and tear off a strip of cloth.
My breathing stays just as slow
My fingerprints are left on you
One more and it ends
I did not shout, I only reached
You fall, and the dream is nearly done
I sit up out of the grave soil
My lids lift halfway
This graveyard begins to dream
I have no place in the spawn tables

lines.zh: 我从土里坐起来，身上全是根须。
lines.en: I sit up out of the soil, roots all over me.
I raise a hand against the light

lines.zh: 我从梦里被拽出来，关节咔咔。
lines.en: Dragged out of a dream, my joints crack.
The air turned cold at once
I step out of the dream
I stand and look over this ground
Soil still clings to me
I slowly turn my body toward you.
I know you are here
This stretch is where I dream
Fire tightens my skin

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，骨头散了
lines.en: I fall from a height and my bones rattle
Muddy water fills my mouth and I thrash
The blast knocked me crooked

lines.zh: 飞来的东西卡在我的骨缝
lines.en: Something flying lodges between my bones
That force tore my dream
Hunger wears the dream thin
Lightning woke me completely
There is no grave soil in the void
